name: ci
on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main]
concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true
jobs:
  gates:
    name: governance gates (size + boundaries + leak)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version: 22
      - name: File-size gate (default-deny, ratchet-only-down)
        run: node scripts/check-file-size.mjs
      - name: Repo-boundary gate
        run: node scripts/check-boundaries.mjs
      - name: Baseline confidentiality leak gate
        env:
          AIOS_LEAK_TERMS_B64: ""
        run: bash scripts/leak-gate.sh .
      - name: Assert private leak terms present on protected main (fail closed)
        if: github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
        env:
          HAS_LEAK_TERMS: ${{ secrets.AIOS_LEAK_TERMS_B64 != '' }}
        run: |
          if [ "$HAS_LEAK_TERMS" != "true" ]; then
            echo "::error::AIOS_LEAK_TERMS_B64 repo secret is missing or empty — the confidential-identifier sweep cannot run, and a baseline-only pass must not look green on trusted events. Reinstall the secret (Settings > Secrets and variables > Actions) from the sanctioned local term file."
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "leak-gate term secret present — the identifier sweep will run."
      - name: Private confidentiality term scan on protected main
        if: github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
        env:
          AIOS_LEAK_TERMS_B64: ${{ secrets.AIOS_LEAK_TERMS_B64 }}
        run: bash scripts/leak-gate.sh .
  lint:
    name: lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version: 22
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then npm ci; elif [ -f package.json ]; then npm install; fi
      - name: Lint
        run: |
          if [ -f package.json ]; then npm run lint --if-present; else echo "no package.json — skipping lint"; fi
  test:
    name: unit tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Checkout AIOS toolkit
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          repository: aiosbrain/aios-workspace
          ref: a48356602eb73c41b6945de8211aabc4064e8a65
          path: toolkit-checkout
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version: 22
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then npm ci; elif [ -f package.json ]; then npm install; fi
      - name: Provision toolkit (deps + operator-loop dist)
        working-directory: toolkit-checkout
        run: |
          npm ci
          # compiled operator loop dist — the spec-eval advisory path loads it via the seam
          npm run build:loop --if-present
      - name: Test
        env:
          AIOS_TOOLKIT_DIR: ${{ github.workspace }}/toolkit-checkout
        run: |
          if [ -f package.json ]; then npm run test --if-present; else echo "no package.json — skipping tests"; fi
  toolkit-drift:
    name: toolkit drift (advisory, core main)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Checkout AIOS toolkit
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          repository: aiosbrain/aios-workspace
          ref: main
          path: toolkit-checkout
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version: 22
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci --ignore-scripts
      - name: Provision toolkit (deps + operator-loop dist)
        working-directory: toolkit-checkout
        run: |
          npm ci --ignore-scripts
          # compiled operator loop dist — the spec-eval advisory path loads it via the seam
          npm run build:loop --if-present
      - name: Test
        env:
          AIOS_TOOLKIT_DIR: ${{ github.workspace }}/toolkit-checkout
        run: |
          if [ -f package.json ]; then npm run test --if-present; else echo "no package.json — skipping tests"; fi
  test-no-toolkit:
    name: tests (no toolkit)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version: 22
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci
      - name: Test without a toolkit (AIOS_TOOLKIT_DIR unset)
        run: npm test
  pack-verify:
    name: pack and install verification
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version: 22
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci
      - name: Pack, verify tarball contents, install into a temp project, run the bin
        run: node --test --test-force-exit test/pack-install.test.mjs
